cues.zh: 今天演讲的主题是货币一个有趣的特性，我想和大家一起探讨。
cues.en: The topic of today's talk is an interesting property of money that I want to explore with you.

cues.zh: 我把这场演讲称为“由内而外：货币作为一种控制体系”。
cues.en: I am calling this [talk], "Inside Out: [Money as a System of Control]."

cues.zh: 在座有谁想告诉我货币的四个主要功能是什么？有人吗？
cues.en: Who here wants to tell me what the four primary functions of money are? Anybody?

cues.zh: 【观众】价值交换？【ANDREAS】交换媒介，这是一个。
cues.en: [AUDIENCE] Value exchange? [ANDREAS] Medium of exchange, that is one.

cues.zh: 【观众】可替代性？【ANDREAS】价值储存，这是第二个。
cues.en: [AUDIENCE] Fungibility? [ANDREAS] Store of value, that is two.

cues.zh: 【观众】可替代性？【ANDREAS】不，那不是货币的用途，而是一种属性。
cues.en: [AUDIENCE] Fungibility? [ANDREAS] No. That is not a use case for money, but it is a property.

cues.zh: 还有两个。记账单位，很好。第四个是什么？控制体系（SoC）。
cues.en: Two more. Unit of account, very good. What is the fourth? System-of-control (SoC).

cues.zh: 什么？我不记得读到过这个。【笑声】结果还真是控制体系。
cues.en: What? I don't remember reading that. [Laughter] System of control, as it turns out.

cues.zh: 我们使用货币已有数万年之久。很难说清货币究竟能追溯到多久以前。
cues.en: We have had money for tens of thousands of years. It is really hard to tell how far back money goes.

cues.zh: 但我们今天的货币与过去的货币截然不同；
cues.en: But the money we have today is very different from the money we have had in the past;

cues.zh: 过去50年里发生了一些变化，从根本上改变了货币的走向，
cues.en: something changed in the last 50 years that has fundamentally altered the course of money,

cues.zh: 改变了货币的走向，[货币是]一种向他人传递价值的系统。
cues.en: of currency, [which is a] system [for] communicating value to other people.

cues.zh: 我们有三个组成部分：交换媒介（MoV）、记账单位（UoA）和价值储存（SoV）。
cues.en: We have the three components: medium of exchange (MoV), unit of account (UoA), and store of value (SoV).

cues.zh: 这些已经存在了几千年。然后发生了一些事。
cues.en: Those have been around for millenia. And then something happened.

cues.zh: 1970年，理查德·尼克松签署了《银行保密法》，将货币变成了一种控制体系。
cues.en: In 1970, Richard Nixon signed the Bank Secrecy Act and turned money into a system of control.

cues.zh: 一种控制体系，把货币当作政治工具，来控制谁能发送或接收它……
cues.en: A system of control that uses money as a political tool, to control who is able to send or receive it...

cues.zh: 以及你能把钱发给谁。
cues.en: and who [you] are able to send money to.

cues.zh: 最终，它的目标是全面监控全球所有金融交易。
cues.en: Ultimately, it aims [for] the complete surveillance of all financial transactions worldwide.

cues.zh: 全面、彻底、极权的金融监控。
cues.en: Complete, total, totalitarian financial surveillance.

cues.zh: 50年前的这一变革，已逐渐渗透到世界上每一个国家、
cues.en: This change, 50 years ago, has gradually percolated throughout every country in the world,

cues.zh: 世界上每一项金融服务、世界上每一家银行。
cues.en: every financial service in the world, every bank in the world.

cues.zh: 1970年，理查德·尼克松将金融服务领域收编，使其成为执法部门的一个分支。
cues.en: In 1970, Richard Nixon deputised the financial services field, to turn them into a branch of law enforcement.

cues.zh: 这种执法跨越国界、跨越司法管辖、超越正当程序、
cues.en: Law enforcement that is beyond borders, beyond jurisdictions, beyond due-process,

cues.zh: 超越政治民主控制与救济途径。
cues.en: beyond political democratic control and recourse.

cues.zh: 警察可以没收你的钱。法官可以签署令状冻结你的账户。
cues.en: A cop can confiscate your money. A judge can sign a warrant to freeze your accounts.

cues.zh: 银行无需任何人授权就能同时做到这两件事，而你对此无能为力。
cues.en: A bank can do both without authorisation from anyone and there is nothing you can do about it.

cues.zh: 这适用于全世界。作为控制系统的货币，凌驾于货币的所有其他功能之上。
cues.en: This applies world-wide. Money as a system of control supercedes all other functions of money.

cues.zh: 当货币变成执法工具，其他功能就开始被侵蚀。
cues.en: When money is turned into an enforcement tool, the other functions start eroding.

cues.zh: 它不再是最好的交换媒介，因为它作为交换媒介的功能……
cues.en: It is no longer the best medium of exchange, because its function as a medium of exchange...

cues.zh: 已经从属于它作为执法系统、控制系统的功能。
cues.en: is subordinate to its function as a system of law enforcement, a system of control.

cues.zh: 控制系统的这一面会腐蚀一切。
cues.en: The system of control aspect corrupts everything.

cues.zh: 互联网革命至今已经25年了。
cues.en: We are now 25 years into the internet revolution.

cues.zh: 智能手机、功能手机……这些上网工具已经普及到……
cues.en: Smartphones, cellphones, dumb phones... [tools for accessing the internet] have propagated out to...

cues.zh: 超过25亿从未接触过这些技术的人手中。
cues.en: more than 2.5 billion people who have never had these technologies before.

cues.zh: 但金融呢？落后了十五到二十年。
cues.en: But where is finance? Lagging fifteen to twenty years behind.

cues.zh: 金融服务尚未覆盖25亿完全没有银行账户的人；
cues.en: [Financial services] have not yet reached 2.5 billion people who are completely unbanked;

cues.zh: 40亿人银行服务不足。
cues.en: 4 billion people underbanked.

cues.zh: 全球只有约15亿人享有完整、特权化、精英式的银行服务……
cues.en: Only about 1.5 billion people have the full, privileged, elite form of banking...

cues.zh: 也就是我们在大多数西方自由民主国家所享受的那种。
cues.en: that we enjoy in most western liberal democracies.

cues.zh: 即便在那里，准入和控制也分层次。这个房间里有 W？
cues.en: Even there, there are tiers of access and control. How many people in this room are accredited investors?

cues.zh: 嗯，多可爱的一群人。（笑声）
cues.en: Mhm, what a lovely bunch. [Laughter]

cues.zh: 这使你们处于全球千分之一中的千分之一中的千分之一的百分位。
cues.en: That puts you in the 1/10 of the 1/10 of the 1/10 percentile of the world.

cues.zh: 金融体系内部存在层级。
cues.en: There are tiers within the financial system.

cues.zh: 有些人拥有更好的渠道和救济途径，而有些人则享有完全的豁免权。
cues.en: Some people who have better access and recourse, and some people who have complete immunity.

cues.zh: 有些人可以对数百万人犯罪：机器人止赎、Libor 欺诈、操纵黄金市场。
cues.en: Some people can commit crimes against millions: robo foreclosures, Libor fraud, rigging the gold markets.

cues.zh: 却永远不会有人坐牢。为什么？
cues.en: And no one will ever go to jail. Why?

cues.zh: 因为当金钱变成一种控制体系时，金融服务公司就成了代理人……
cues.en: Because when money becomes a system of control, financial services companies become deputies...

cues.zh: 在这个执法与控制系统里。
cues.en: in this system of enforcement and control.

cues.zh: 作为代表，他们享有某些特权。其中一项是：他们永远不会坐牢。
cues.en: As deputies, they get some perks. One of the perks is: they never go to jail.

cues.zh: 当然，也有少数例外；有些基本规则始终适用于我们的社会。
cues.en: Well, with a few exceptions; there are some fundamental rules that always apply to our society.

cues.zh: 伯尼·麦道夫进了监狱。他犯的错是偷富人的钱。别这么干！[笑声]
cues.en: Bernie Madoff went to jail. He made the mistake of stealing from rich people. Don't do that! [Laughter]

cues.zh: 取消1000万穷人的房屋赎回权？在富国银行开设350万个虚假账户？没问题。
cues.en: Foreclose [the homes of] 10 million poor people? Create 3.5 million fake accounts in Wells Fargo? No problem.

cues.zh: Equifax因黑客攻击泄露1.43亿个人私密记录？
cues.en: Lose 143 million private records of individuals [through a hack] at Equifax?

cues.zh: 来看看赌注吧。有多少高管会坐牢？一个也没有。
cues.en: Let's see some bets. How many executives [will] go to jail? None.

cues.zh: 控制体系腐蚀了货币的基础，直至其无法再作为交换媒介运作。
cues.en: A system of control corrupts the basis of money until it can no longer function as a medium of exchange.

cues.zh: 它滋生了经济排斥。
cues.en: It breeds economic exclusion.

cues.zh: 互联网时代至今已有25年，而我们在经济包容性上覆盖的人却越来越少。
cues.en: We are now 25 years into the era of the internet and we are reaching fewer people with economic inclusion.

cues.zh: 我们实际上正在历史性地倒退。
cues.en: We are actually backtracking historically.

cues.zh: 越来越多的整个国家正被切断了与全球金融体系的联系。
cues.en: Increasingly, entire countries are being cut off from the world financial system.

cues.zh: 你不按美国的利益行事？
cues.en: You don't act in the best interests of the United States?

cues.zh: 你失去SWIFT代码，就不再是电汇网络的一部分。
cues.en: You lose your SWIFT code, you are no longer part of the wire transfer network.

cues.zh: 你就得服从美国法院的普遍管辖权，就像瑞士不得不做的那样，
cues.en: You [will] submit to the universal jurisdiction of American courts, like Switzerland had to do,

cues.zh: 否则你就失去国际银行业务的准入。
cues.en: or you lose access to international banking.

cues.zh: 你失去储备货币的准入，就失去了贸易的命脉。
cues.en: You lose access to the reserve currency, you lose access to the lifeblood [of trade].

cues.zh: 这桩魔鬼交易使金融服务在竞争层面变得不可撼动。
cues.en: This devil's bargain has made financial services unassailable from a point of competition.

cues.zh: 它们被层层法规包围；这些法规并非为了保护消费者，
cues.en: They are surrounded by a thicket of regulations; these regulations are not about consumer protection,

cues.zh: 消费者显然没有得到保护。
cues.en: consumers are most certainly not protected.

cues.zh: 它们无疑关乎货币的控制体系。
cues.en: They are most certainly about the system of control of money.

cues.zh: 它们关乎政策执行，有时还关乎伴随货币而来的政治执行。
cues.en: They are about the policy enforcement, and sometimes politics enforcement, that comes with money.

cues.zh: 货币并非自由流动。
cues.en: Money does not flow freely.

cues.zh: 我有个坏消息。那些围绕并保护银行免受竞争的金条，是一座镀金的牢笼。
cues.en: I have some bad news. Those gold bars surrounding and protecting banks from competition are a gilded cage.

cues.zh: 这座牢笼将它们困在监管体系之内，阻止外部竞争，
cues.en: A cage that keeps them inside a system of regulation, prevents competition from the outside,

cues.zh: 但也阻止它们在自由市场中践行创新[理念]、拓展业务，
cues.en: but also prevents them from acting on innovative [ideas] in free markets, expanding their businesses,

cues.zh: 除非它们服从于一套控制体系。
cues.en: unless they subordinate it to a system of control.

cues.zh: 价值储存[用例]已不再奏效；你无法将价值储存在一种货币中……
cues.en: The store-of-value [use case] no longer works; you cannot store value in a currency...

cues.zh: 那种货币可能被随意没收，被任何银行家在任何时间点冻结。
cues.en: that can be confiscated at a whim, frozen by any banker, at any point in time.

cues.zh: 那不是稳定的价值储存手段。
cues.en: That is not a stable store of value.

cues.zh: 你不能把它当作货币储备来买石油，也不能当作国家的外汇储备。
cues.en: You cannot use it as your currency reserve to buy oil, or as your foreign exchange reserve in your country.

cues.zh: 如果你得罪了超级大国，他们就会切断你的访问权限，你就买不到石油了。
cues.en: If you cross the superpowers, they will cut off your access and you will not be able to [buy] oil.

cues.zh: 如果货币不能自由兑换给你想兑换的任何人，它就不能作为交换媒介。
cues.en: You cannot use money as a medium of exchange if you cannot exchange it freely with whoever you want.

cues.zh: 腐败逐渐蔓延开来。
cues.en: Gradually, the corruption spreads and spreads.

cues.zh: 现在，新事物出现了：一个在网络上运行的货币体系。
cues.en: Now, something new arrives on the horizon: a system of money that [operates] on a network.

cues.zh: 它首先是交换媒介、价值储存手段，有朝一日还可能成为记账单位。
cues.en: It is first and foremost a medium of exchange, a store of value, and one day (potentially) a unit of account.

cues.zh: 但它永远不会成为控制体系；它拒绝成为控制体系。
cues.en: But it will never become a system of control; it refuses to become a system of control.

cues.zh: 事实上，它的设计原则是中立、开放、无国界访问、抗审查。
cues.en: In fact, its design principles are about neutrality, openness, borderless access, censorship resistance.

cues.zh: 银行无法涉足那个领域。它们被困在镀金的牢笼里，替超级大国充当警察……
cues.en: The banks can't play in that space. They are stuck inside their gilded cage, playing cop for superpowers...

cues.zh: 只向极少数人口提供金融服务。
cues.en: and [only] offering [financial] services to a tiny fraction of the human population.

cues.zh: 它们以贫穷为祭坛，牺牲了40亿人，只为制造一种美好而虚假的、
cues.en: They are sacrificing 4 billion people on the altar of poverty in order to create a nice, fake,

cues.zh: 中产阶级式的安全感——靠向他们兜售谎言。
cues.en: bourgeois sense of security among the middle class -- by selling them lies.

cues.zh: FDIC说：“别担心，你的钱有保险。”对吧？
cues.en: FDIC: 'Don't worry, your money is insured.' Right?

cues.zh: 在座有多少人的银行账户有FDIC或同等保险？
cues.en: How many people here have FDIC or equivalent insurance on their bank accounts?

cues.zh: 你觉得有多少希腊人的银行账户有保险？
cues.en: How many Greeks do you think had insurance on their bank accounts?

cues.zh: 所有人都有。结果呢？一个下午就化为乌有！
cues.en: All of them. What happened to that? [Their savings went] poof! in one afternoon.

cues.zh: 消失了，直接缩水20%。
cues.en: Vanished, with a 20% haircut.

cues.zh: 谁的保险？保的是你，还是保的是银行？保的到底是什么？
cues.en: Whose insurance? Does it insure you or does it insure the banks? What does it insure against?

cues.zh: 小失败，不是大失败。大失败是无法保险的。
cues.en: Small failure, not big failures. Big failures are uninsureable.

cues.zh: 你们有多少人在银行里有存款？你们都没在银行里有存款。（笑声）
cues.en: How many of you have money in banks? None of you have money in banks. [Laughter]

cues.zh: 拜托。你们很多人是律师，对吧？你们懂委托保管。那不是你的钱。
cues.en: I mean, please. Many of you are lawyers, right? You understand bailment. It is not your money.

cues.zh: 你有一个“账户”，这是一种法律构造，是他们给你的，用来交换你给他们的……
cues.en: You have an "account," which is a legal construct that they give you in exchange for giving them...

cues.zh: 你的钱作为无担保贷款，好让他们能为客户提供信贷融资。
cues.en: your money as an unsecured loan, so that they can finance credit to their customers.

cues.zh: 从法律上讲，你账户里的钱，你一分都不拥有！
cues.en: Legally, you don't own any of the money that is in your account!

cues.zh: 你拥有的是一种法律构造，它可能、也许赋予你按他们（设定）的节奏取款的权利，
cues.en: You have a legal construct that possibly, maybe entitles you to withdraw at the pace they [set],

cues.zh: 除非你得罪了不该得罪的人，去了不该去的抗议，跟不该有关的组织有来往，
cues.en: unless you cross the wrong person, go to the wrong protest, associate with the wrong organisation,

cues.zh: 或者投票给了不该投的政党。
cues.en: or vote for the wrong party.

cues.zh: 当然，也许在加拿大不会发生这种情况。
cues.en: Sure, maybe that is not happening in Canada.

cues.zh: 但在194个国家中，这种将金钱变成控制系统的模式……
cues.en: But out of a hundred and ninety-four countries, this model of turning money into a system of control...

cues.zh: 已经像野火一样蔓延开来，因为这是每个独裁者的美梦。
cues.en: has taken off like wildfire, because it is every dictator's wet dream.

cues.zh: 它确保政治异见可以在银行被扼杀，非常有效。
cues.en: It ensures that political dissent can be snuffed at the bank, very effectively.

cues.zh: 这是现存最有效的控制系统之一。
cues.en: It is one of the most effective systems of control that exist.

cues.zh: 现在它必须面对一个不会这样做、也无法被强迫这样做的系统的竞争，
cues.en: Now it has to face competition from a system that will not do that, cannot be made to do that,

cues.zh: 不会屈服，也不会被收编。
cues.en: will not yield or be co-opted.

cues.zh: 回应是什么？“比特币是个笑话。”“加密货币在系统之外。”
cues.en: What is the response? "Bitcoin is a joke." "Cryptocurrencies are outside the system."

cues.zh: “没人想待在系统之外。”你猜怎么着？外面有60亿人。
cues.en: "Nobody wants to be outside the system." Guess what? There are 6 billion people out there.

cues.zh: （他们中的大多数人）不想待在系统之外；他们更愿意待在系统之内。
cues.en: [Most of them] don't want to be outside the system; they would much rather be inside.

cues.zh: 但他们没被邀请，而且很可能也不会被邀请。
cues.en: But they haven't been invited and they probably won't be.

cues.zh: 他们中许多人做不到被系统接纳所必需的那些事。
cues.en: Many of them can't do the things that are necessary to be invited into the system.

cues.zh: 你猜怎么着？整整一代人已经发现了两种至关重要的权力形式：
cues.en: Guess what? There is an entire generation that has discovered the two [vital] forms of power:

cues.zh: 第一种形式是发声，第二种形式是退出。
cues.en: the first form is voice, the second form is exit.

cues.zh: 要么你发声，表达你的政治意愿去迫使改变。
cues.en: You either speak up with your voice, and express your political will to force change.

cues.zh: 当那不起作用时，你就选择所有人都拥有的第二种关键权力：退出。
cues.en: When that doesn't work, you [opt for] the second [vital[ power that all humans have: exit.

cues.zh: 几千年来，边界被建立起来，就是为了阻止退出、延缓退出。
cues.en: Borders have been erected for millenia to prevent exit, to slow down exit.

cues.zh: 你没法轻易移民、退出、离开、走人。
cues.en: You can't easily emigrate, opt out, depart, exit.

cues.zh: 当退出不是一种物理行为，而是一种虚拟行为时，会发生什么？
cues.en: What happens when exit is not a physical act, but a virtual act?

cues.zh: 当人们决定以虚拟方式退出金融系统时，会发生什么？
cues.en: What happens when people decide to exit from the financial system in a virtual way?

cues.zh: 退出虚拟现实？退出比特币？［笑声］
cues.en: VR-exit? Bit-exit? [Laughter]

cues.zh: 镀金笼子的内部，你们可以留着。
cues.en: You can keep the inside of the gilded cage.

cues.zh: 它在人口上停滞不前，杠杆过度，债台高筑，而且失控。
cues.en: It is demographically stagnated, over-leveraged, swimming in debt, and out of control.

cues.zh: 它只服务于极小一部分人。你们可以留着它。
cues.en: It serves a tiny sliver of the population. You can keep it.

cues.zh: 整整一代千禧一代不再相信银行安全的那种虚构，
cues.en: An entire generation of Millennials no longer believe in that fiction of bank security,

cues.zh: 不再相信延后收益、利率和房贷。
cues.en: of deferred earnings, of interest rates and mortgages.

cues.zh: 他们会退出；他们正在成群结队地退出。
cues.en: They will exit; they are exiting in droves.

cues.zh: 不仅在这里，在那些现有内部人金融体系……
cues.en: Not just here, but even more so in the countries where the existing system of insider finance...

cues.zh: 以及控制体系被专制、压迫性地使用的国家，情况更是如此。
cues.en: and the system of control are used despotically, oppressively.

cues.zh: 中国正在成群结队地退出，而这才刚刚开始。
cues.en: China is exiting in droves and it has barely started.

cues.zh: 比特币已经存在九年了。内部人集团做了什么？
cues.en: Bitcoin has been around for nine years. What does the insider group do?

cues.zh: 面对一个无法被监管的体系，监管者做了什么？
cues.en: What do the regulators do in response to a system that cannot be regulated?

cues.zh: 他们管控能管的部分：交易所、银行账户和本国货币那一块。
cues.en: They regulate the bits they can: the exchanges, bank accounts, and national currency side of things.

cues.zh: 他们关掉入金通道和出金通道。他们说：“我们不会让你把钱带走。”
cues.en: They shut down the on-ramps and off-ramps. They say, "We will not let you take your money with you."

cues.zh: 千禧一代怎么回应？“哥们……我压根儿就没钱啊！”
cues.en: What do Millennials say to that? "Dude... I don't have any fucking money!"

cues.zh: [笑声]“我有的只是我的创造潜力、我的精神、我的生产力。”
cues.en: [Laughter] "All I have is my creative potential, my spirit, my productivity."

cues.zh: “我可以直接把这些换成比特币，不需要交易所，不需要入金通道，也不需要出金通道。”
cues.en: "I can sell that directly for bitcoin without an exchange, an on-ramp or an off-ramp."

cues.zh: “等我需要买东西时，我会直接用我的数字货币……
cues.en: "When I need to buy something, I will use my digital currency directly...

cues.zh: 不用再进入你们那个系统——那个从来就没邀请过我的系统。”
cues.en: without re-entering your system - to which I was never invited."

cues.zh: “关掉入金通道，关掉出金通道。我就待在船上。我就待在数字世界里。”
cues.en: "Shut down the on-ramps, shut down the off-ramps. I will stay on board. I will stay digital."

cues.zh: 我不再碰你们那个镀金的笼子了，因为我不需要你们。我退出。”谢谢。
cues.en: I won't touch your gilded cage anymore, because I don't need you. I exit." Thank you.
